_doc: Which v83 scrolls (Item.wz/Consume/0204.img) are in the game, by item slot -> family (the stat it improves) -> rate. Rates: '100', '60', '10' (plain) and 'dark70', 'dark30' (dark: a failure can destroy the item). Only the ids are ours; every scroll's stats, info/success and info/cursed come from WZ unchanged. Out: event 65%/15%, 50%, the 'strong' 100% (stats of the 10% scroll), Balrog's, Chaos, Clean Slate, White and the other classes' weapon scrolls. tier C (our selection; v83 has no INT scroll for tops or bottoms and none is invented). 2040016 (hat Accuracy 10%) is in: its WZ info/success is the string 10 (a number in quotes), which the loader casts. The hat DEX/ACC, top LUK and bottom DEX scroll lines exist twice in v83 (an old and a newer series), both are listed as separate families. The families live in the per-line fragments scrolls/<line>.json (common = armour slots, then one file per job line); DataRepo.load_all merges them per slot in that order, so a later file can add families to a slot, and a repeated slot+family is an error (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4).
